en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is not befitting for the man to leave behind (for someone) the butter for oil, nor the oil for the butter’.
en.sarwar: 15. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
It is not valid for a man to make advance payment in the form of ghee to receive oil and vice versa.’”
